title: Prime-order abelian coefficient case
statement: For a projective family over a field with geometric fibres of dimension at most one, the higher direct image of the constant abelian sheaf with value ULift (ZMod ℓ) is constructible whenever ℓ is prime and invertible on the base.

source.place: Proof, application of thm-fin-projective-curve-constant and coefficient forgetting

proof.text: Apply the prime-coefficient constructibility theorem for module sheaves and transport the result through the exact forgetful functor to abelian sheaves, using the canonical derived direct-image coefficient comparison.

lean.statement: theorem finite_group_prime_abelian_case (k : Type u) [Field k] (X S : Over (Spec (.of k))) [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType S.hom] [QuasiCompact S.hom] (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProjective f.left] (hdim : ∀ s : S.left, topologicalKrullDim (pullback f.left (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S.left.residueField s) (AlgebraicClosure (S.left.residueField s)))) ≫ S.left.fromSpecResidueField s) : Scheme.{u}) ≤ 1) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (hinv : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(S.left, ⊤))) (q : ℤ) : Scheme.IsConstructibleAbelianSheaf ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor (Sheaf S.left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) q).obj ((Etale.rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f.left).obj ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor (Sheaf X.left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) 0).obj ((constantSheaf X.left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)))))))
